<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v1.13.1 -->

## What's Changed
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* fix(deps): backport filelock 4 upgrade to 1.13.1 by @Adam-Aghili in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15966
* fix: confine Git loader files to repository by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15972
* fix(oracle): confine loader local file access by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15973
* fix(security): protect MCP component reserved fields by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15974
* fix(security): isolate MCP batch login and request state by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15978
* fix: secure quickstart PostgreSQL configuration by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15979
* fix(auth): restrict external resolver credentials by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15980
* fix: require OAuth attestation for Slack workspace routing by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15981
* fix: separate user and flow storage namespaces by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15982
* fix: fence stale listener delivery across trigger replicas by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15942
* fix(agentic): check implicit calls in component definitions by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15943
* fix(models): validate unified model credential destinations by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15944
* fix(mcp): validate final shell arguments after headers by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15946
* fix(python): require isolation for untrusted global imports by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15945
* fix: stop listeners when background consent is withdrawn by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16012
* fix(security): pin agentic MCP calls to the backend listener by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16044
* fix(logging): redact credentials from query strings by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16042
* fix(security): validate component connection targets by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16043
* fix(security): block runtime readers in generated components by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16040
* fix(security): enforce MCP HTTP destination policy by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16041
* fix(security): block shipped inspect re-export bypasses by @Adam-Aghili in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16048
* fix: preserve SSO triggers during migration replay by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16058
* fix: block assistant expression evaluation bypasses by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16055
* fix: absorb image dependency CVE workarounds for 1.13.1 by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16121
* fix(deps): dependency upgrades for 1.13.1 by @Adam-Aghili in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16131
### 📝 Documentation Updates
* docs: clarify autologin behavior in install and quickstart by @mendonk in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15968
### 🛠 Maintenance Tasks
* build: remove the unused MCP Fetch development dependency by @Adam-Aghili in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15585
### ✅ Tests
* test(audio): cover packaged worklet playback and startup failures by @Adam-Aghili in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15584
* test(mcp): cover safe authenticated global and project tool listings by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16047
* test(a2a): cover safe agent-card discovery after owner deactivation by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16045
* test(mcp): cover component policy before tool input preprocessing by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16046


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/compare/v1.13.0...v1.13.1
